name: ALLEY BOOT
tagline: first contact with an analog dimension

entities.text:
HELLO, PIX. {left}/{right} TO MOVE, {jump} TO JUMP.
YOU ARE A 16x20 GUEST IN A 4K WORLD.
TRY NOT TO LOOK COMPRESSED.

GAPS: JUMP. BIG GAPS: JUMP AGAIN, MID-AIR.
PHYSICS HERE IS DISTURBINGLY ANALOG.

{dash} TO DASH. YOU'RE BRIEFLY INVULNERABLE,
LIKE A WELL-WRITTEN FIREWALL RULE.

SPIKES ARE RUDE. DOUBLE JUMP OVER THEM.
NOBODY IS COMING TO FIGHT YOU HERE.
THE LOCALS JUST WANT YOU OUT OF THE ALLEY.

{jack} TO JACK IN. DIRECTIONS PICK THE PORT.
YELLOW PORTS PULL YOU TO THEM.
THEY'RE THE ONLY THINGS HERE THAT SPEAK TCP.

WALLS ARE STICKY. JUMP BETWEEN THEM.
EVERYTHING HERE IS A LITTLE STICKY. EW.
